bio.text: Lucy Dathan has represented the 142nd House District in New Canaan and Norwalk since 2019, and for 2025-2026 is House Chair of the Government Oversight Committee.
She was born and raised in St. Louis, Missouri, and studied accounting and business at Santa Clara University.
She qualified as a Certified Public Accountant, worked in finance in Poland and London, and has served as chief financial officer of technology companies; she moved to New Canaan in February 2015.
